## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Subiksham Catering?
No. 13, Arasu 2nd Cross Street, Krishna Nagar, K.K. Thazai, MMC, Chennai 600 051.

### What facilities does Subiksham Catering have?
Wedding catering, Engagement, Reception, Corporate events, Get-togethers, Birthday parties, House warming, Puberty function, Baby shower, Wedding planning, Event management, Wedding photography, Wedding hall, Menu tasting.

### Is your food completely vegetarian?
Yes. We specialise in pure vegetarian cuisine: South Indian, North Indian and contemporary dishes.

### Do you offer tasting sessions?
Yes, we can arrange a menu tasting so you can try our dishes before finalising.
